title: Amazon search & charts
description: Two row types share one dataset: product (one search result or chart entry, charged) and status (per keyword or category, free).

dataset.title: Amazon search & charts
dataset.description: One row per product from a search page or category chart, plus status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
